直接保存时按实际选择自动识别；剪贴板保存由此标注: Direct capture detects the selection type; clipboard capture uses this label
布尔模式使用置入前选中的实体作为目标。原位置粘贴始终保持独立对象。: Boolean modes use the selected solids as targets. Paste in place always creates independent objects.
直接读取选中模型，不占用系统剪贴板。: Read the selection directly without using the system clipboard.
从剪贴板保存，请先手动复制模型。: Copy the model before saving from the clipboard.
从模型生成正交缩略图和三维预览，需要连接 Plasticity；上传的预览图优先: Generate orthographic thumbnails and 3D previews from the model. Requires Plasticity. Uploaded images take priority.
组件置入和保存暂不可用。请启动后台服务，连接恢复后可继续使用。: Insertion and capture are unavailable. Start the backend to reconnect.
组件置入、自动复制和模型操作已停用。请在控制中心恢复模型连接。: Model operations are paused. Resume the connection in the control center.
请重新打开已安装插件的 Plasticity。直连恢复后，即可保存选中模型和置入: Reopen Plasticity with the plugin installed to enable direct capture and insertion.
保存一次，随时置入。在 Plasticity 里继续创作。: Save once and insert anytime in Plasticity.
预览在后台生成，仍可保存和置入: Previews run in the background; capture and insertion remain available
打开 Plasticity，在连接设置中选择目标窗口。: Open Plasticity and select a target in connection settings.
直接保存时自动识别类型: Direct capture detects the type automatically
按住右键移动旋转 · 松开恢复: Hold right mouse to rotate · Release to reset
换个关键词，或者查看全部组件。: Try another keyword or browse all components.
归档的组件会保留模型数据，随时可以恢复。: Archived components retain their model data and can be restored anytime.
选择一个组件，查看信息或置入到当前模型。: Select a component to view details or insert it into the current model.
组组件使用定位置入，保留部件顺序与组信息: Group components use positioned insertion to preserve order and group metadata
选中模型并完成当前工具后保存，无需系统剪贴板。: Select the model and finish the current tool before saving. No clipboard required.
先在 Plasticity 复制模型，再保存剪贴板中的组件。: Copy the model in Plasticity, then save it from the clipboard.
库和分组用于组织已保存的组件。: Use libraries and groups to organize saved components.
查看模型连接，管理组件库的运行状态。: View model connections and manage the component library service.
组件置入和保存暂不可用。请重新启动后台服务。: Insertion and capture are unavailable. Restart the backend service.
组件置入、自动复制和模型操作已停用；恢复连接后可继续使用。: Model operations are paused. Resume the connection to continue.
打开模型窗口即可使用内嵌组件库。: Open a model window to use the embedded library.
连接已暂停；浏览和整理组件仍然可用。: Connection paused. Browsing and organizing remain available.
打开 Plasticity 后，这里会显示可用窗口。: Open Plasticity to see available windows here.
托盘图标始终保留后台入口，双击可打开此控制中心。: Double-click the tray icon to open this control center.
关闭此页面会保留后台服务。退出后台后，模型置入需重新启动服务。: Closing this page keeps the backend running. Quitting the backend disables insertion until restarted.
组件数据会保留。Plasticity 会继续运行，组件库置入功能将在重新启动后台: Component data is preserved and Plasticity keeps running. Restart the backend to enable insertion again.
按住右键移动旋转，松开恢复: Hold right mouse and move to rotate; release to reset
右键拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放: Right-drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
在 Plasticity 中选中模型，\n点击保存组件即可直接读取并保存。以后只: Select a model in Plasticity and save it. Insert it later with one click.
导出当前库全部组件: Export all components in this library
导出当前库中此分类的所有组件，不受搜索、类型或分组筛选影响: Export every component in this category in the current library, regardless of search, type or folder filters
请先重启后台，启用批量导出: Restart the backend to enable batch export
检测版本和目录，安装后重新启动 Plasticity 即可使用 Tab 面板。: Detect versions and folders, then restart Plasticity after installation to use the Tab panel.
请重启后台，启用插件安装管理: Restart the backend to enable plugin installation management
其他目录：输入 Plasticity 安装目录完整路径: Other folder: enter the full Plasticity installation path
未检测到安装，可输入其他安装目录。: No installation found. Enter another installation folder.
此版本尚未支持自动安装: Automatic installation is not supported for this version
正在运行，请先保存并关闭此版本所有窗口: Running; save and close all windows of this version first
将恢复已验证的原始入口，组件数据库保留。: Restore the verified original entry and retain the component database.
将修改此版本的内嵌入口，并自动保存可恢复备份。: Update this version's embedded entry and automatically save a recovery backup.
请先自行保存并关闭该版本所有窗口；继续后在安装窗口确认 Windows 权限。: Save and close all windows of this version first; then confirm Windows permission in the installer.
